newsitem.title: USA: Successories in kiosk deal with Borders.
newsitem.headline: Successories in kiosk deal with Borders.

text.p: Successories Corp said Thursday is signed a letter of intent to enter into a multi-year agreement with the Walden Book Co unit of Borders Group Inc to install holiday kiosks this year.

The agreement calls for Successories to operate 100 kiosks at Waldenbook stores at retail malls nationwide between September 1 and January 31, starting in 1997. The agreement follows a five-kiosk test that took place during the 1996 holiday shiopping season.
Successories said the holiday period accounts for about 60 percent of its annual sales.
Financial terms were not announced and the program must still be approved by the boards of Borders and Successories.
Successories is a specialty retailer and catalog comapny.
Its shares were up 1/4 Thursday at 6-1/8.
